sources.title: Spotting Sensitive Data in Spanish Healthcare: The New OpenMed PII Model
sources.snippet: Handling personally identifiable information (PII) in clinical data is a significant challenge for developers, especially when navigating strict data privacy regulations. Enter the new OpenMed/OpenMed-PII-Spanish-BiomedBERTFull-Base-110M-v1 model from Modelers.cn. Designed specifically for the Spanish language, this tool automates the identification of sensitive fields—such as patient names ...

sources.title: OpenMed / OpenMed-PII-Spanish-BiomedBERTFull-Base-110M-v1-mlx
sources.snippet: This is a Spanish biomedical token-classification model that identifies personally identifiable information (PII) in clinical text, enabling de-identification before data sharing. It is a 110M-parameter BERT encoder based on BiomedBERTFull, packaged in MLX format for efficient inference on Apple Silicon.
